svg.text: WF-011 Async APB stream CDC (clock ratio and wait duration illustrative only)
reserved; not popped before DMA burst ack
staged; not committed before DMA burst ack

One APB stream beat is one bundled-data CDC transaction. The request and response buses remain stable until their matching toggles return. Queue effects execute only in the timer domain. DMA burst acknowledgement, not an APB beat, releases capture records or commits compare/update batches. The illustrated clock ratio, phase and wait duration are not timing requirements.
